answer.reason: The marked verses in 2 Kings tell what Shalmaneser did to Hoshea and to Samaria.

clauses.english: shut up Hoshea and bound him in prison
clauses.quote: the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison

clauses.english: besieged Samaria for three years and captured it
clauses.quote: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it

clauses.english: carried Israel away captive into Assyria
clauses.quote: the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria

doubts: The marked verses in Isaiah and 2KI 17:24-27 say only 'the king of Assyria' without naming Shalmaneser, so they were left out.
2KI 17:4-6 also say only 'the king of Assyria', but they continue the account of Shalmaneser begun in 2KI 17:3, and 2KI 18:9-11 repeats it with his name.
